# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** 16
- **Gender:** Female
- **Status:** Alive
- **Rank:** Noblewoman / Mage Student
- **Origin:** House Pembroke, Bergmann Empire
- **Role:** Student at the Royal Academy
- **Titles:** Daughter of Count Pembroke

## Appearance

Isolde is a striking young noblewoman with long, elegantly styled hair and sharp, refined facial features. She carries herself with impeccable posture, reflecting her highborn upbringing. Her choice of attire typically consists of tailored, high-grade Academy robes decorated with subtle family crests.

## Personality

Isolde is proud, highly ambitious, and deeply conscious of her noble heritage. She places great value on dignity and decorum, often holding others to the same rigorous standards she sets for herself. Despite her somewhat aloof and competitive exterior, she possesses a strong sense of responsibility and takes her obligations as a mage and noble seriously.

## Traits

- Proud and dignified
- Competitive
- Conscious of social status
- Fear of failing her family's expectations

## Abilities

- Proficient in elemental magic
- Expertise in formal noble etiquette and diplomacy
- Tactical mana management

## Goals

- Bring honor to House Pembroke through top academic and magical achievements
- Establish herself as one of the premier mages of her generation at the Royal Academy

## History

Isolde entered the Royal Academy as one of the prominent noble freshmen of her intake. During the initial orientation and practical evaluations, she demonstrated superior spellcasting control, aiming to secure a top position among her peers. She maintained a keen rivalry with other talented students, monitoring any commoners or lower nobles who threatened to disrupt the traditional hierarchy. As events unfolded during her first term, she participated in mandatory combat exercises, proving her resilience and tactical discipline under pressure.

## Background by volume

- Raised as the daughter of the influential Count Pembroke
- Received extensive private tutoring in magic and noble comportment prior to entering the Academy

## Affiliations

- House Pembroke — Daughter / Heir candidate
- Royal Academy — Student
